issues.problem: Story said Xiang Yu broke out with 'a few horsemen' (Shiji: some eight hundred) and added the interpretive 'believing his homeland lost'; the lament is sung in his tent the same night.
issues.action: Corrected to some eight hundred horsemen, dropped the interpretation, described the song as a lament naming his horse and consort Yu.

issues.problem: Cue (old man planting trees for decades against a desert), ctx2 (治沙) and ctx5 (old man planting trees) fit 愚公移山 (cy588, same set) as well or better.
issues.action: Rewrote the cue around one young woman cleaning an ocean beach; replaced ctx2 with volunteers against ocean rubbish and ctx5 with a bereaved mother's lone campaign.

issues.problem: ctx3 (villages sharing a river, cleaning pollution together) and ctx5 (tourism and restaurants must be planned together) only express close connection, where 息息相关 (cy499) fits as well.
issues.action: Rewrote both so that one party's collapse directly brings down the other (shared dyke breaking; tourism collapsing closes restaurants).

issues.problem: ctx6 applied it to a factory process described as 日臻成熟 ('steadily maturing'), which contradicts the sense of skill already perfected.
issues.action: Replaced with a veteran welder's lifelong, perfected skill.

issues.problem: ctx3 (people who still hand-write letters) is mere scarcity, where 寥寥无几 (cy198) fits as well; ctx1 English 'as rare as gold' added an image not in the Chinese.
issues.action: ctx3 now about craftsmen who can repair antique clocks (a precious skill); ctx1 English changed to 'extremely rare'.

issues.problem: Story said the water was 'half as shallow as before', which garbles Magu's words (水又浅于往者会时略半).
issues.action: Changed to 'only about half as deep as at their last meeting'.
